context_requirements: Functional GABA-A or GABA-B receptor expression on the assayed cell line
Neuronal lineage or exogenous receptor expression, absent in the nine lines used here
GABAergic signaling machinery capable of modulating transcription within 6-24 h
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine lines
Shared transcriptional signature across multiple lines that matches known GABA receptor activation
Changes in genes such as GABRA1, GABRB2, or GABBR1 after treatment
